name: VirusTotal
label: VirusTotal API v3 — URL/file/IP/domain reputation
description: Official VirusTotal API v3 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.virustotal.com/reference/overview. scan-file uploads a platform file ref-id and shares the sample with VirusTotal (vendor analysis + Community). POST /files admits files up to 32MB; larger files need /files/upload_url (not in this node). Prefer get-file-report by hash. api_key is header x-apikey. Never log the key or file bytes.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path/query/body keys match api_spec.json.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: scan-url | scan-file | get-file-report | get-url-report | get-ip-report | get-domain-report | search.

schema.label: url
schema.description: URL to scan. Required on scan-url. Example: https://example.com. https://docs.virustotal.com/reference/scan-url

schema.label: file
schema.description: File to scan. Required on scan-file. Platform file block. POST /files is multipart.

schema.label: id
schema.description: File hash (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256) or URL id for report ops.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Public GET /search query (hash, URL, domain, IP, or comment tag). Not Premium intelligence search.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb when input.operation is blank.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: VirusTotal API key. Header x-apikey (empty prefix). StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT or in logs.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive; <=0 → 25. Use 120 for large scan-file.
